title: Uniquely Ergodic Branching Subset Currents on Free and Surface Groups
summary: \emph{Subset currents} on free groups, on surface groups and, more generally, on word-hyperbolic groups, were introduced by Kapovich and Nagnibeda, and further studied by Sasaki. Subset currents extend ordinary geodesic currents and provide measure-theoretic generalizations of conjugacy classes of infinite quasiconvex subgroups. Their supports can be viewed as ``branching laminations". For free groups and surface groups, we construct non-rational subset currents with genuinely branching supports that carry no other subset currents except scalar multiples.
